Class KicHandler<C extends BaseComponent<HTMLElement, C>>

java.lang.Object
org.patternfly.component.KicHandler<C>
public class KicHandler<C extends BaseComponent<HTMLElement, C>> extends Object
A utility class for handling EventType.keydown, EventType.keyup, EventType.input, and EventType.change events in components with an HTML input element.
